provenance.extraction: scripts/extract_published.py; no simulation rerun, histogram rebinning, or inferred data

conditions.amplitudes: fixed; paired is phase shift pi of same realization
conditions.lpt_growth: exact LCDM through order 3; EdS D1^4 at fourth order
conditions.native_nbody: BullFrog; 64 steps; 2N PM; fd4 force gradient; 2LPT initial conditions at z=24

field_meanings.pdf: density per unit log10(rho), normalized within displayed rho range 0.05..20
field_meanings.quantiles_rho: full-field density at quantile_probabilities; not log density
field_meanings.mass: each cell weighted by its unsmoothed deposited mass, with the smoothed rho sampled in that cell
field_meanings.volume: equal weights for Eulerian analysis cells
field_meanings.captured_probability: null: archived stats do not record out-of-range mass or volume
field_meanings.S3: connected third moment divided by variance squared
field_meanings.S4: connected fourth moment divided by variance cubed
field_meanings.crossing: fractions are 0..1, not percentages; original study signed-tetrahedron history

restrictions: This is a mostly single-stream filtered realization, not a strictly uncrossed mask: N-body ever-crossed mass is about 0.52% fixed and 0.69% paired.
These unconditional PDFs include that small crossed fraction; copula mask results are separate and not included here.
Sub-percent accuracy is statistic- and scale-dependent; 4LPT dense tails and variance at 7 Mpc/h exceed 1% error.
One 300 Mpc/h box, one 14 Mpc/h initial filter and a paired phase check do not establish accuracy for arbitrary cosmologies or initial spectra.
Archive replay is distinct from live Rust experiments; no data here certify the Rust port.
Sheet histograms integrate the piecewise-linear P0 representation by exact overlaps; this does not remove sheet-resolution, N-body, cell-window or aliasing errors.

estimators.label: Exact P0 sheet
estimators.description: Six Kuhn tetrahedra per Lagrangian cube; R3D exact overlap deposit; cell-average window deconvolved before top-hat smoothing

estimators.description: Same native snapshots; particle CIC deposit and CIC window deconvolution before top-hat smoothing
